Privacy Policy

Effective date: August 16, 2026

This policy explains how the ADBTweaks website handles the information you provide when you register to be notified about the ADBTweaks release. It applies only to this website and the signup form. The Android app itself is covered by the separate Privacy Policy packaged inside the app.

1. What we collect

When you use the release update form, we ask for:

  • Email address — required, so we can notify you when the Google Play release is available.
  • Target Android version — required; helps us prioritize compatibility testing.
  • Device model — optional; used only to prioritize testing against the devices people use.

We do not ask for, and do not require, a name, account, or password.

2. How we use it

Your information is used only to:

  • Notify you when ADBTweaks is available on Google Play, and
  • Occasionally understand the Android versions and devices that registrants plan to use so we can test them.

We do not use your data for advertising, for building advertising profiles, or for anything unrelated to the ADBTweaks release.

3. Who processes it

Submissions are received by an API endpoint hosted by Vercel. The API uses a private Google Cloud service account to write registration data to a restricted Google Sheet. The service-account credentials are stored only as server-side deployment secrets and are never sent to your browser.

4. Sharing

We do not sell, rent, or trade your information. It is shared only with:

  • Vercel, which hosts the website API endpoint, and
  • Google, because the registration row is stored in Google Sheets.
  • Service providers needed to send release notification emails, if email delivery is handled by a third-party mailing service.

5. Retention

Registration data is kept for as long as it is useful for distributing the release and its updates. If you want your registration removed from our list, contact us using the details below and we will remove it promptly.

6. Security

The form is submitted over HTTPS. Google service-account credentials are kept in server-side environment variables and are not exposed to the browser. The API validates fields, restricts cross-origin submissions, and rejects duplicate email registrations. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

7. Your rights

You may at any time:

  • Ask what information we hold about you,
  • Ask us to correct or delete it, or
  • Unsubscribe from release notifications.

To do any of these, contact us using the details below.

8. Children

This website and the ADBTweaks app are not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

9. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page will be updated when it changes. Continued use of the website or the signup form after changes means you accept the updated policy.

Contact

Questions about this policy or requests to access or delete your registration can be sent through the ADBTweaks update channel: @mister_p27official on YouTube.
